base_url.description: DriveHOS/Lucid ELD Partner API origin. The official Swagger document is hosted at https://api.drivehos.app/partner/swagger/doc.json and declares root-relative /v2 paths. Override only if Lucid/DriveHOS supplies a different Partner API origin.

provider_api_key.description: Provider API Key (with rate limiting), sent as the X-API-Provider-Key header.

company_api_key.description: Company API Key (no rate limiting), sent as the X-API-Company-Key header.

vehicle_id.description: Vehicle ID used by the vehicle_location_history stream path. Single-vehicle direct reads can also pass vehicle_id as a command flag.

start_date.description: Required vehicle location history start date in the official wire format MM-DD-YYYY.

end_date.description: Required vehicle location history end date in the official wire format MM-DD-YYYY.
